 ESPN's College GameDay Bus Boise State Athletics Shares Additional Fan Information for ESPN’s College GameDay
 11/12/2026 4:27:00 PM | Football, General
 Share: Activities for fans of all ages  
 BOISE, Idaho – Boise State Athletics will host ESPN's College GameDay Built by The Home Depot this week. Fans are invited to join the fun and help show the nation what makes Bronco Nation special.  
More information regarding College GameDay, including fan information, can be found below and at BroncoSports.com 
 College GameDay at Boise State 
Frequently Asked Questions 
 EVENT INFORMATION 
 When is College GameDay? 
College GameDay will broadcast live from Boise State on Saturday, Nov. 14. The show airs from 7-10 a.m. MT, with live television segments beginning around 5:30 a.m. 
 Where will College GameDay be located? 
The set will be located on DeChevrieux Field, on the west side of Albertsons Stadium. 
 Where can I enter DeChevrieux Field? 
General admission entrances for all open areas outside "The Pit" will be at the North, West and East entries to DeChevrieux Field. Standard stadium screening will take place at all three entrances. 
 What time do gates open? 
Gates to DeChevrieux Field will open at 4:30 a.m. MT on Saturday, Nov. 14. 
 FAN ACCESS AND EXPERIENCE 
 Are there any policies to wait in line? 
Each person must be present to hold a place in line. Holding a place for someone who is not there is not allowed. Everyone in line must remain awake; sleeping or lying down is not allowed. 
 Can I set up a tent? 
Camping is not allowed on Boise State property. Tents, sleeping bags, and other camping equipment or bedding are not permitted. A small blanket is allowed. 
 How should I prepare for the weather? 
Early November mornings in Boise are cold; dress in warm layers and school colors. Umbrellas and ponchos are encouraged.
Umbrellas and ponchos are allowed while waiting. Dress for cold and rainy weather, including warm layers and a waterproof outer layer. 
 Do I need a ticket to attend College GameDay? 
No. College GameDay is free and open to the public. No tickets or advance registration are required. 
 Are there any prizes for fans who arrive early? 
Yes. The first 50 fans in line will receive exclusive College GameDay prize packs. 
 Can I still attend if I do not arrive early? 
Absolutely! Bronco fans are welcome throughout the morning. While the front-row pit and prize packs are limited to early arrivals, everyone is encouraged to join the excitement. 
 What can I bring into DeChevrieux Field? 
Large bags, backpacks and seating (chairs or stools) are not allowed inside DeChevrieux Field. There will be an area to leave chairs and other large items. Items will be unsecured; please plan accordingly. Boise State does not accept responsibility for any items left in this area. 
 Standard stadium screening will take place at all three entrances. 
 Will restrooms be available? 
Yes, portable restrooms will be available. 
 FAN ACTIVITIES 
 What type of activities will be happening on-site? 
Food, entertainment, sign-making stations and prizes will be available throughout the night, thanks to Boise State and campus partners. 
 Will food be available? 
Boise State partners will provide free food and drink, while supplies last, throughout the night and morning. Scheduled food and drinks include support from Albertsons, Chartwells, Coca-Cola, Idaho Pizza Company, R&R BBQ, Simplot, Taco Bell, and Treasure Valley Coffee. 
 Alcohol is not permitted. 
 Where can I buy College GameDay and Bronco merchandise? 
The Blue and Orange Store will be on site in front of the Allen Noble Hall of Fame to sell merchandise starting on Friday afternoon. 
 GameDay Bus Photo 
This season, to align with THD's "Ready. Get Set. It's GameDay" campaign thematic, The Home Depot is creating a replica façade of the GameDay Bus and inviting fans aboard, giving them the opportunity to "drive" and share the moment with friends. Groups of 4-5 fans, clad in THD Hard Hats will enter the façade for a memory they'll never forget! 
 What are the College GameDay sign regulations? 
One of the most beloved traditions associated with College GameDay is the making of signs. No vulgar signs, .com, .net, .org, political or religious signs are allowed. For fans entering the pit, signs cannot be on poles or oversized. All signs brought to Saturday's taping will be inspected before entry and must abide by College GameDay's sign policies or will be removed. 
 PARKING AND TRANSPORTATION 
 Where can I park if I am attending College GameDay? 
Parking on the Boise State campus will be limited due to the Bronco volleyball and football games taking place later in the day. 
 Designated public parking opens at 2 a.m. and costs $20 per space for the day, including the football game. Parking is first come, first served at Lincoln Avenue Garage, Brady Street Garage, and the Grant East and West lots. Follow event signs and staff directions. 
 Accessible parking is available first come, first served on the ground floor of Lincoln Avenue Garage. A valid accessible plate or placard is required.  
 A free, wheelchair-accessible shuttle from Lincoln Avenue Garage begins at 2 a.m. 
 Manitou Avenue and Grant Avenue will close between Belmont Street and University Drive from midnight Saturday until the game ends. 
 How much does parking cost? 
Parking costs $20 per space for the day. 
 Can I use my Boise State football season parking pass? 
Yes. Fans with a football season parking pass for the east or west parking lots may access their designated parking areas beginning at 2 a.m. MT on Saturday, Nov. 14. 
 All normal football gameday parking policies will be in effect starting at 2 a.m. 
 WATCHING COLLEGE GAMEDAY 
 Where can I watch College GameDay if I cannot attend in person? 
Fans can watch College GameDay on the following platforms: 
 ESPN 
 ESPNU 
 ESPN App 
 Disney+ 
 What time should I tune in? 
The show airs from 7-10 a.m. MT, with live television hits around 5:30 a.m. MT. 
 ESPN's College GameDay FAQ 
 What is College GameDay Built by The Home Depot? 
ESPN's College GameDay Built by The Home Depot is college football's premier pre-game show. The show travels to a different college campus or game site each week of the season from late August/early September through the College Football Playoff National Championship in January. The locations - usually announced a week in advance - are chosen by ESPN based on competitive matchups, rivalries, and other factors. 
 How can I watch the live broadcast? 
College GameDay airs at 9 AM ET - Noon ET on ESPN and ESPNU throughout the football season and is available for streaming through the ESPN App. ESPN's social and digital pre-pre-game show Countdown to College GameDay begins at 8:30 AM ET weekly and is available to watch on a number of social and streaming platforms, including the ESPN App. 
 How do I get selected to stand in the pit during the live broadcast? 
Students and fans have the opportunity for an up-close view of the show by standing in the pit immediately adjacent to the stage. Selection is on a first-come, first-served basis for all fans. Students admitted to the pit are encouraged to wear school colors and should have a numbered wristband. Participants are subject to ESPN security procedures and policies. 
 What is the ESPN policy for pit participants? 
The following items are prohibited in the pit: bags (of any kind), food and drinks, pens, pencils, markers or dry erase boards and signs on sticks. Throwing objects is prohibited in the pit. A number of sign regulations are required as well. 
 What are the College GameDay sign regulations? 
One of the most beloved traditions associated with College GameDay is the making of signs. No vulgar signs, .com, .net, .org, political or religious signs are allowed. For fans entering the pit, signs cannot be on poles or oversized. All signs brought to Saturday's taping will be inspected before entry and must abide by College GameDay's sign policies or will be removed. 
 Do I need an ID? 
You will need a physical ID to participate in PAT MCAFEE'S KICKING IS EASY CONTEST. 
 How can I participate in Pat McAfee's Kicking Contest? 
Eligible fans ages 18 and older can enter for a chance to attempt a 33-yard field goal by obtaining a raffle ticket in the College GameDay Pit before the show begins. A maximum of 300 tickets will be distributed on a first-come, first-served basis. Current and former collegiate athletes are not eligible. For additional eligibility requirements and contest details, please review the Official Rules. 
 Visit ESPN's College GameDay Hub . 
 About College GameDay Built by The Home Depot 
ESPN's College GameDay Built by The Home Depot enters its 40th season in 2026 – and 33rd originating from game sites. College GameDay has won the Sports Emmy in 2026, 2025, 2024, 2018, 2017, 2016, 2015, 2014, 2011, 2010 and 2008 for best weekly studio show; in 2021, 2019 and 2018 for best technical studio team; in 2018 and 2023 for outstanding sports feature: short form; and in 2026 for outstanding edited sports special for "Not So Fast, My Friend: A Lee Corso Special," totaling 17 Sports Emmys for the premier college football pregame show. College GameDay airs every Saturday at 9 a.m. ET on ESPN, ESPNU, the ESPN App and Disney+ throughout the college football season.
